o: Jackie returns to Silver Falls after a summer in New York, determined to make amends with Alex and set boundaries with Cole. Alex is focused on rodeo training, while Cole finds himself struggling to fill the void left by football. Jackie must navigate the complexities of the Walter family and her own identity, ultimately facing a crucial choice that could significantly impact her future in…

eps.o: Back from New York City, Jackie learns that picking up where she left off with the Walters won't be easy — especially with Alex and Cole.

eps.t: My Life Without the Walter Boys
eps.o: Jackie channels her energy into keeping a tradition alive. Katherine and George are forced to loosen their reins — whether they want to or not.
In his new role, Cole struggles to separate leadership from friendship. Jackie and George discover that letting go of the past is harder than expected.
An impulsive brag sends Jackie and Grace on a club-hopping quest. The gridiron heats up as the Big Horns seek redemption against their archrivals.
Paris comes to Silver Falls High at an enchanting fall formal. But not everyone will leave the dance with their dignity intact.
After an incident at the ranch, the Walters reassess what's most important to them. Jackie delivers an emotional message to the junior class.
With no room for distraction, Alex kicks up dust to achieve his dream. Determined to start anew, Cole faces an uphill climb.
A college fair sparks tension — and opportunity — at Silver Falls High. As horns lock over the ranch's future, Will gets caught in the middle.
Couple trouble brews beneath the surface at Skylar's Halloween spooktacular, while a reminder of loss reawakens Jackie's bittersweet feelings.
Jackie, Cole and Alex face tests of focus and courage in the runup to Silver Falls' annual festival. But it's their hearts that will be tested most.
